# ECODrIx

> ECODrIx is a unified business infrastructure platform combining CRM, AI automation, WhatsApp Business API, email marketing, B2B lead intelligence, and cloud storage. It powers the ERIX product suite (ERIX-CRM, ERIX-FLOW, ERIX-LAIE, ErixStore, Relay Fabric). Founded March 2024 by Dhanesh Mekalthuru.

ECODrIx replaces 5–10 separate SaaS subscriptions with one platform. The marketing site is at https://ecodrix.com, the application at https://console.ecodrix.com, the public REST + Socket.IO API at https://api.ecodrix.com, and the founder's portfolio at https://portfolio.ecodrix.com.

## Platform modules

- [ERIX-CRM — Sales pipeline & client portal](https://ecodrix.com/platform/crm): Kanban pipeline, AI lead scoring, unified activity timeline, project workspaces, secure client portal.
- [WhatsApp Business API & unified inbox](https://ecodrix.com/platform/whatsapp): Official Meta Cloud API, template messages, broadcasts, real-time inbox over Socket.IO.
- [ERIX-FLOW — Visual automation engine](https://ecodrix.com/platform/automation): Drag-and-drop canvas, conditional logic, custom-node marketplace, real-time run logs.
- [ERIX-LAIE — B2B lead intelligence](https://ecodrix.com/platform/lead-intelligence): Lead discovery, AI dossier research with Claude and Gemini, enrichment, outreach kits.
- [Email marketing on AWS SES](https://ecodrix.com/platform/email-marketing): Drag-and-drop builder, segment targeting, A/B tests, drip campaigns.
- [Cloud storage & AI assets](https://ecodrix.com/platform/cloud-storage): Cloudflare R2, presigned URLs, AI-generated alt text and color palettes.
- [Client portal & project workspace](https://ecodrix.com/platform/client-portal): Branded portal, milestones, secure messaging, R2 file attachments.
- [ErixStore — In-memory database](https://ecodrix.com/platform/erixstore): Sub-millisecond reads, AOF + BGSAVE persistence, distributed queue, pub/sub, locks.
- [Relay Fabric — Distributed worker engine](https://ecodrix.com/platform/relay-fabric): Auto-provisioning workers across regions, region-aware routing, proxy rotation.

- [Pricing page](https://ecodrix.com/pricing): Free plan available with every product included; paid tiers from ₹2,999/month.

## API & developers

- [API base URL](https://api.ecodrix.com): REST endpoints for CRM, conversations, automation, lead intelligence, storage, client portal.
- [WebSocket events](https://api.ecodrix.com): Socket.IO at wss://api.ecodrix.com — real-time messages, run progress, relay health, notifications.
- [Authentication](https://ecodrix.com/platform): Tenant API key (x-api-key + x-client-code), LAIE key (x-laie-key), platform session, portal Bearer JWT, core admin key.
